## Test evidence

No tests were run by this reviewer. Read retained red.log, drain-only.log, green.log and existing-scripts.log and the embedded report output. RED reproduces five of seven failures on original production with the new regression. Drain-only restores transport/acceptance but leaves closed-pipe failure. Final `bash tests/super-auto/projection-output-r1.sh` reports 7 tests OK, 204381-byte valid and 204542-byte gap projections with exits 0/3, and real acceptance consumers retaining 126 refs. `bash tests/super-auto/test-scripts.sh` reports All super-auto script tests passed. Evidence is plausible, relevant and matches the captured tree. The reported cleanup sequence distinguishes active test processes from post-test leaks; no leak is reported.
